items.title: Ahab
items.charge: Marrying Jezebel; serving Baal; sparing Ben-hadad whom the Lord appointed to destruction

items.title: Esau
items.charge: Despising his birthright; marrying Hittite wives; purposing to kill his brother

items.title: Israel in the days of the Judges
items.charge: Serving Baalim and Ashtaroth; intermarrying with the Canaanites; every man doing right in his own eyes

items.title: Jehoram of Judah
items.charge: Slaying all his brethren with the sword; walking in the way of the house of Ahab; making high places and compelling Judah to fornication

items.title: King Solomon
items.charge: Multiplying foreign wives; building high places to their gods

items.title: Samson
items.charge: Marrying a Philistine; going in to a harlot; betraying his Nazarite vow to Delilah

items.title: The returned exiles who married strange wives
items.charge: Mingling the holy seed with the peoples of the lands

items.title: Zimri and Cozbi
items.charge: Bringing a Midianite woman into the camp in the sight of the congregation
